description_en: Retrieves the download URL of a recording file based on the number pool key, call record ID, call start time, and other parameters
description_zh: 根据号码池Key、呼叫记录ID、呼叫发起时间等获取录音文件的下载链接
name: QueryRecordFileDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en:
The number pool key.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console.

Required when ProductType is empty
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key。

当ProductType为空时必填
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Valid values:
AXB_170
AXN_170
AXN_95
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE

This parameter applies to former Alidayu customers and can be ignored by Alibaba Cloud users.
Required when PoolKey is empty
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值：
AXB_170。
AXN_170。
AXN_95。
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE。

适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略。
当PoolKey为空时必填
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The call record ID, which is used to identify a call record.

You can obtain the call record ID by using one of the following methods:
Query call records on the Call Record Query (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call) page in the console to obtain the call record ID.
View the call_id field in the Recording Status Report receipt message
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫记录ID，用于标识一条通话记录。

获取方式如下：
在控制台呼叫记录查询 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call)页面进行查询，获取呼叫记录ID。
在录音状态报告回执消息中查看call_id字段
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en:
The call start time in the call record.

You can obtain the call start time by using one of the following methods:

Query call records on the Call Record Query (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call) page in the console to obtain the call start time in the Call Time column.
View the call_time field in the Recording Status Report receipt message.

CallTime does not support parameters in the timestamp format
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫记录中的呼叫发起时间。

获取方式如下：

在控制台呼叫记录查询 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call)页面进行查询，获取呼叫时间列的呼叫发起时间。
在录音状态报告回执消息中查看call_time字段。

CallTime不支持传入时间戳格式的参数
parameters.name: call_time

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the recording file. The URL is valid for 2 hours
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 录音文件的下载链接URL。URL链接的有效期为2小时

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
